entries.name: Decline Oblique Crunch
entries.reason: Source-bound side-view draft with a spine that curls and shoulders that turn. Legs secured on a decline bench, torso partway down, one hand beside the head and the other on the thigh; the trunk curls up while the shoulders turn so the raised elbow travels toward the opposite knee, a pause, and a slower return. The hips stay on the bench. One side is shown; the last caption carries the change of sides. Seen from the side, the turn shows as the near shoulder and elbow coming forward. Not drawn: the decline angle is not given by the source, so 20 degrees is a drawing choice.
entries.summary: Legs secured on a decline bench with the torso partway down, curl up while turning so the raised elbow travels toward the opposite knee, pause, lower slowly, then change sides.

frames.caption: Secure the legs on a decline bench and lean back until the torso is partway down, one hand beside the head and the other on the thigh.
Curl the torso up while turning it so the raised elbow travels toward the opposite knee.
Pause at the top. Turn the ribs, lead with the shoulder.
Complete the repetitions on one side, then change sides.
